summary: This video follows a parent on a day off as they pick up their child from school and walk around the neighborhood. It highlights simple everyday happiness, sunny weather, and cooking a tasty meal for the family.

phrases.quote: 今天休假，接送儿子上下学
phrases.usage: Use this word whenever you want to talk about things happening today!
phrases.example_en: The weather is very nice today.

phrases.quote: 寒窗苦读，终能实现梦想
phrases.usage: Use this word to talk about your big dreams and hopes for the future.
phrases.example_pron: Wǒ de mèngxiǎng shì dāng yīshēng.
phrases.example_en: My dream is to become a doctor.

phrases.quote: 今天天气依旧晴朗，我带大家看看我家附近
phrases.usage: Use this word when talking about sunny, rainy, or chilly days outside.
phrases.example_en: The weather is really hot today!

phrases.quote: 看到一家麦当劳，可以买个汉堡
phrases.usage: Use this fun word whenever you want to order or talk about burgers!
phrases.example_en: I want to eat a hamburger.

phrases.quote: 哈哈，本来想拍点秋天的落叶
phrases.usage: Use this to describe the cozy autumn season when leaves fall.

phrases.quote: 快到放学时间了，在校门口来接孩子
phrases.usage: Say this when the school day ends and it is time to go home!
phrases.example_en: We finish school at three o'clock.

phrases.usage: Use this to describe yummy food that tastes fantastic!

phrases.quote: 可口的饭菜，健康的身体、 和家人在一起就是快乐和幸福
phrases.usage: Use this word to talk about staying strong, healthy, and happy.
Shout this out at home when delicious food is ready on the table!
Say or write this friendly line at the end of a video or show-and-tell.
phrases.example: 我的故事讲完了，谢谢观看！
phrases.example_pron: Wǒ de gùshì jiǎng wán le, xièxie guānkàn!
phrases.example_en: My story is finished, thanks for watching!
